const prev = $('ValidateEvent').first().json;
const diffResponse = $input.first().json;
const diff = typeof diffResponse.data === 'string' ? diffResponse.data : (typeof diffResponse === 'string' ? diffResponse : JSON.stringify(diffResponse));
const maxLen = 100000;
const truncated = diff.length > maxLen;
const truncatedDiff = truncated ? diff.substring(0, maxLen) + '

... (diff truncated)' : diff;
const prompt = 'Review this pull request. Respond in Japanese.

Use this EXACT format:

## Review Summary
- Critical: <count>
- Major: <count>
- Minor: <count>

## Findings

### [CRITICAL] <title>
- File: <path>
- Line: <number or range>
- Issue: <description>
- Fix: <suggested fix>

### [MAJOR] <title>
(same format)

### [MINOR] <title>
(same format)

Categories:
- CRITICAL: Bugs, crashes, security vulnerabilities, data loss
- MAJOR: Logic errors, missing error handling, test gaps
- MINOR: Style issues, naming, documentation

If no issues found:
## Review Summary
- Critical: 0
- Major: 0
- Minor: 0

No issues found.

---
PR: ' + prev.prTitle + '
Repository: ' + prev.repoFullName + '

Diff:
' + truncatedDiff;
const geminiBody = JSON.stringify({
  contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
  generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, maxOutputTokens: 8192 }
});
return [{ json: { ...prev, geminiBody, diffLength: diff.length, truncated } }];
